data.narrative:
Drafter is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Chris Barton and Peter Atkin, having raised $3M+ to date. The broader Robotics & Manufacturing sector includes one public comparable (277810.KQ) and eight private peers, among them Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI.

The Stage-Progression method is the primary applicable approach here. Using total capital raised ($3M) as a valuation proxy and applying a typical Seed-to-Series A step-up multiplier of 2.5x yields an implied value of $8M. The Peer-Median method is not reliably applicable: while eleven same-sector companies exist, filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier peers yields fewer than three datapoints, making a sector median comparison structurally misleading.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $6M (low) to $9M (high), with a median point of $8M. This range reflects a conservative 15% discount and 8% premium around the stage-progression result. Key uncertainties include the absence of sufficiently comparable Seed-stage precedents within the narrower robotics cohort and reliance on a single valuation method. Future rounds and revenue traction will provide stronger triangulation anchors.
